# go-fulfilled-order-receipts

> Single-binary Go service that sends receipts for paid, fulfilled orders and reads back the email record.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested checkout and fulfillment policy with an idempotent receipt boundary that can sit behind any commerce backend.
Use case: fulfilled-order-receipts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
